description: Search and download Streamline icons, illustrations and design elements.

interface.longDescription:
Search the Streamline library of icons, illustrations and emojis, and download the ones you pick as SVG or PNG.

Describe what you need in plain language, such as a concept, a UI element or a visual style, and Streamline returns matching assets to preview and download.

You can also ask which icon family suits your product, browse the sets inside a family, and get advice on picking clear, consistent icon metaphors for your interface or design system.
